title: Who Pays in Gold
summary: The raiders carried gold they never looted, which means someone paid them to attack. Follow their tracks to a Pillager Camp (It Takes a Pillage), kill eight pillagers (patrols and outposts count too) and find their ledger in a barrel.

goals.say: Smoke, palisades, and a banner with a golden eye stitched over the illager face.

goals.name: Ledger of Tithes

quest_book.title: Ledger of Tithes
quest_book.author: Camp Quartermaster
pages: Received of the Faithful: 40 gold. For the village by the hill. Burn nothing. Take people.
Payment owed on delivery to the Sacred City. Souls by weight. The Chariot pays in full.

goals.say: Ashford. Tonight. You have to warn them.
